'''Cancelled expansions''' are Star Wars CCG sets Decipher announced after [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]] and never published. The five sets are numbered 33–37, following [[Theed Palace]].<ref name="cardguide">[https://cardguide.fandom.com/wiki/Star_Wars_CCG Star Wars CCG], CardGuide Wiki</ref>

Decipher's preview ''After Death Star II'' said the classic trilogy on cards would keep growing as character-themed expansions, not a straight walk through the films.<ref name="after">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050307015419/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/whatisit/afterdeathstar.html After Death Star II], Decipher.com (Internet Archive, 7 March 2005)</ref> The Death Star II Starter Deck rulebook carried a full-page ad for the first two of those sets.

== Death Star II starter ad ==

[[File:SoTE-Skywalkers-Ad-DSII-Starter-Deck.webp|400px|Death Star II Starter Deck rulebook advertisement]]

The Star Wars Customizable Card Game continues with '''''Shadows of the Empire''''' and '''''Skywalkers''''', the next two expansion sets, coming soon!

<blockquote>
'''Shadows of the Empire''' includes exciting new cards from the best-selling novel. Prince Xizor and Dash Rendar will be featured, along with their starships and a host of other characters and images in stunning photo-realistic detail!

'''Skywalkers''' will be the next full expansion in the Star Wars CCG. Not tied to the timeline of the film trilogy, it will be free to explore many aspects of the entire ''Star Wars'' universe. Many cards and themes will concentrate on Luke, Leia and… of course… Darth Vader.
</blockquote>

The page is copyright 2000 Decipher Inc., Norfolk, Virginia, used under Lucasfilm authorization.

== What shipped instead ==

Lucasfilm asked Decipher to mix ''The Phantom Menace'' into the original-trilogy game. [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] (May 2001) was originally framed as a Skywalker-family set and was rebuilt around podracing and Episode I characters.<ref>https://cardguide.fandom.com/wiki/Tatooine_(expansion)</ref> [[Coruscant (expansion)|Coruscant]], [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III]], and [[Theed Palace]] followed; Theed Palace (12 December 2001) was the last Decipher expansion.

A Light Side [[Mara Jade]] photograph from the same shoot as the Dark Side Enhanced Jabba's Palace card never became a retail card. Planned extra language editions and anime-style Japanese cards also never shipped. Card leftovers are on [[Unreleased cards]]. Language editions, including the cancelled German and Spanish releases, are on [[Translations of SWCCG]]. The cancelled German release is on [[Cancelled German release of SWCCG]]. The Spanish Two-Player rules booklet from that program is on [[Spanish Premiere Two-Player Game rules booklet]].<ref name="encyc" />

The Players Committee later published virtual cards, beginning in 2002. Those sets are listed on the [[Main Page]] under Virtual Legacy (2002–2014) and current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward). They are not these cancelled Decipher expansions.
